title: Q-CLAIM-COVER-agents-AGENTS-md: unbound claim-like statements on agents/AGENTS.md
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** claims coverage, every PR and daily
**Done check:** coverage of agents/AGENTS.md is 100%
**Status:** open

COVERAGE-1: 52 claim-like lines (first 17) on `agents/AGENTS.md` state a number, cadence or guarantee with no registered claim and probe.

Bind each to a probe in `doctrine/claims.json` (or generate the sentence from code), or change the words to what the code does.

size: S
